name: The Back Room
tagline: Pizzeria by day, something else by night
description: Your team runs a pizzeria in the mall: dough, three sauces, toppings from shrimp to pineapple, the oven, drinks from the tap, customers at the counter. The lift at the back goes down to the cellar: a blue cabinet with supplies ordered from the shop, plants under a lamp, a shredder and a mixer. Some customers come for what is made down there. In the evening the rude ones stand under the red lamp, and there is a button under the counter. The patrol comes by when you least expect it.
